description: The power consumption of large-scale AI clusters is massive, with a 100GW cluster consuming a significant fraction of total annual US electricity production.

instances.assertion: The power consumption of large-scale AI clusters is massive, with a 100GW cluster consuming a significant fraction of total annual US electricity production.
The largest AI training clusters are projected to require power equivalent to over 20% of current US electricity production by 2030.
AI training runs are projected to require gigawatt-scale power by 2030, with some data centers already reaching 1.2-2 GW.
